title: Fur Capelet & Snowy Forest
prompt: An original young woman with long, fair hair under a deep fur-lined hood looks up and to the side. She wears a fur capelet with a brown ribbon tie at the throat over a cream wool coat. Tall snow-covered evergreens rise behind her. Her expression is calm and dreamy. Soft, diffused winter light. Palette of cream, taupe, and snowy white. Wintry and romantic, in the style of a fairytale winter editorial.
workingNotes:
- The fur capelet and ribbon tie are the signature details.
- Keep the snowy trees for a storybook backdrop.
